# linkdrop

> linkdrop is a self-hosted link inbox. Share a link from your phone and it saves a markdown file that you or an agent can read later. Made by SCTY Lab.

- Source: https://github.com/SCTY-Inc/linkdrop (MIT license)
- Runtime: Node 22 or later. One file, Node built-in modules only.
- Server: `node server.js`, port 18790 by default (`PORT`). Captures go to `CAPTURE_DIR` (default `/raw`).
- API: `POST /links` or `POST /capture` with JSON (`url`, `text` or `content`, `title`, `note`, `channel`) or multipart with one file. `GET /health`.
- Storage: one folder per capture, `YYYY-MM-DD-<content-hash>-<title>/capture.md` with YAML frontmatter. A capture is written once and never rewritten. A same-day exact retry returns the first receipt.
- Capture does not fetch or summarize the page. `enrich.js <capture-id>` can fetch public context later and writes a create-only `enriched.md`.
- The server has no authentication. Keep it on a private network.

## Quickstart

```sh
git clone https://github.com/SCTY-Inc/linkdrop && cd linkdrop
CAPTURE_DIR=~/linkdrop-inbox node server.js
# in a second terminal
curl -X POST localhost:18790/links -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"content":"https://example.com"}'
```
